title: FEWER RAID MESSAGES
why: his complaint 10-27: too many messages reach the player (he left the design to us; built to the research rule of that night). Only the ladder reaches the screen: danger or teammate down, extraction, teammate news, a goal done, and the answer to something that did not work; the rest go to the run log, which the pause box lists. The left feed shows 3 lines that fade out after 5 s and takes one new line every 2.5 s; a goal done waits out the fight. His order 10-27 ~22:35 (the game told him about extraction b far across the map): an exit closing is said only for the exit you are heading to or one within 60 m. Kill lines, contract item nearby and all of looting are as they were. Measured in a staged 3 minute raid (seed 4242: looting, a fight, an extraction): 43.3 lines a minute before, 30 after
now: fewer raid messages: only danger, extraction, your teammate, goals done and failed tries show; the rest is in the run log on the pause box (43.3 to 30 lines a minute)
